question: Vietnam released economic reformation policy named 'Doi Moi' from 1986 to 2000. Evaluate the effectiveness of the policy based on the gini score trend of the country in 2 phases: Before 1986 and after 1986
query: SELECT gini_reported, year  FROM country_income  WHERE "country" = 'Vietnam' AND        ("gcam_region_id" < 30 OR "gcam_region_id" > 50)  AND year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985  UNION ALL  SELECT gini_reported, year  FROM country_income  WHERE "country" = 'Vietnam' AND        ("gcam_region_id" < 30 OR "gcam_region_id" > 50)  AND year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009;
